title: Good but no way to turn off alarm.
text:
Good but no way to turn off alarm.. Very accurate and a great replacement. We can't do without thermometers.

I like that this one has an alarm system that alerts you when a temperature rises above a certain degree. however, the alarm can be quite annoying, especially if you are using it to test different meats at different temperatures. Because the thermometer didn't arrive with instructions, I had to figure out on my own how to shut it off: setting the minimum temp at a very high level. This way, I still get my accurate readings, but the alarm won't sound until it reaches that ridiculously high temp.

product_metadata.title: Meat Thermometer, Instant Read Thermometer, Digital Meat Thermometer with Can Opener, 2 in 1 Kitchen Thermometer with Probe, Backlight, Calibration, Alarm Thermometer for Cooking
features: 【2 IN 1 MEAT THERMOMETER WITH PROBE】- This instant read thermometer has one more external extension probe compared to traditional grill thermometer, which allows the oven door to be closed the whole time, help you cook the most delicious grilled meat. Unfold the digital meat thermometer and it starts to read immediately. If there’s no operation, it’ll auto-switch off after 5 minutes. It also can lock the temp through the “Hold” button, letting you see the temp closely.

【Super Fast & Accurate】- Instant read meat thermometer can measure food temperature in just 2-3 seconds. The food thermometer has a wide temperature range of -58°F ~ 572°F (--50°C ~ 300°C), supports both Celsius (°C) and Fahrenheit (°F) display, and can be accurate to ±1 degree. Perfect for indoor outdoor cooking, grilling, BBQ and so on.

【Large Screen & Easy to Store】 This food thermometer comes with a large backlight screen, enabling you to see the temp clearly whether in a poorly lighted kitchen or outdoors of too much light. With an internal magnet and large hang hole, this probe thermometer works as a bottle opener and it can be easily hung on the fridge with the magnet on the back. You can stick it on the fridge or hang on the hook, conveniently store this where you can have easy and quick access!

【ALARM SETTING】: Set an alarm to your desired temperature, the alarm will sound and the and the numbers will also turn red when the temperature reaches the preset temperature. No need to keep opening the oven and checking the temperature constantly. An nice digital meat thermometer for grilling.

【A MUST HAVE AT HOME】: This kitchen thermometer is a great helper for kitchen, air fryer, cooking, BBQ, grilling, oven, smoker, candy making, deep frying, baking. Suitable for cooking beef, chicken, pork, fish, turkey etc. We offers a 1-year warranties for all orders, if you are not satisfied with the product or have any questions, our customer service team will help you with a REFUND or RETURN.
